properties.name: completed
properties.description: Whether this step is completed (shows a check / fills its connector).

properties.name: active
properties.description: Whether this step is the active one. Usually managed by the parent.

properties.name: error
properties.description: Whether this step is in an error state.

properties.name: errorText
properties.description: Error message shown beneath the label (overrides `description` on error).

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Manually disable the step (parent's `mode="linear"` also gates reachability).

properties.name: optional
properties.description: Mark the step optional — shows an "Optional" caption and may be skipped.

properties.name: editable
properties.description:
Editable: a completed step shows an edit (pencil) affordance, and — with
`auto-complete` on — revisiting it preserves downstream completion
(review/edit in place). Revisiting a non-editable step restarts progress
from there.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Override the indicator glyph (Material Symbols name), e.g. "lock".

properties.name: completedIcon
properties.description: Glyph shown when completed (Material Symbols name).

properties.name: errorIcon
properties.description: Glyph shown when in error (Material Symbols name).

properties.name: accessibleName
properties.description: Full override for the announced accessible name (i18n escape hatch).

properties.name: hideActions
properties.description: Hide the built-in Back / Continue actions in the vertical content panel.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

name: Step
description: One step inside an md-stepper. An indicator (number, dot, check, pencil or error glyph), a label, an optional supporting line, and — where the layout calls for it — the step's own content panel.

notes: Rendered by its stepper: the header control (a button named like the source, disabled when unreachable, expanded / collapsed with a panel), its panel and actions are the stepper's own layout, so the authored order is the keyboard order. A step's own style hooks apply to that step.
Standalone (no stepper) it renders like the source with its data-* defaults (first, horizontal, shared panel) and its own active.

Parts: typed part appearances (.awcStepPartAppearance(_:part:) / AWCStepPartAppearanceScope) — bubble / dot colour and corner radius (winning over the state colours), label / optional / description colour and text metrics (font size / weight / line height, letter spacing), connector colour, state-layer colour, content background and padding (outside the grid track), actions gap (Mac Chrome ::part cases, web-paint-extra2).

macOS SwiftUI, the iOS simulator and the Android emulator are verified against Chrome 153: paint (142 cases + per-step hooks and step density), the state / motion replays per frame (20 runs, plain and reduced motion) with the md* events, the announcements and the keyframe animations each step starts.
